create.name: Luisa Muhr
create.bio:
Luisa Muhr is a Family and Systemic Constellations facilitator and interdisciplinary artist living in New York City. Born in Vienna, with Hungarian and Anatolian-Greek family roots, she grew up around constellation circles that her mother hosted at home, joined them herself as a teenager and later certified with the German facilitator and astrologer Peter Orban, an early associate of Bert Hellinger. Her own family history, including a great-grandfather who survived the Holocaust, shapes her interest in how unspoken stories pass down the generations.

In her groups, participants stand in for members of a seeker's family and follow what they sense, bringing hidden patterns into view; one-to-one, she works through guided inner imagery instead. She holds workshops at venues in Manhattan and Brooklyn, online circles, private and couples sessions and a yearly training for new facilitators, and she leads weekends at Kripalu. A certified Deep Listening practitioner in the tradition of Pauline Oliveros, she is also a vocalist, composer and performance artist, and she treats art and constellation work as two routes to the same kind of attention.

courses.title: Family and Systemic Constellations: A Workshop for Profound Healing
courses.description: A weekend constellation circle at Kripalu in which a few seekers, chosen by lot, have their family systems set up while everyone else takes part as representatives or observers. Luisa guides the group in noticing who is missing or out of place in a family and what shifts when they are acknowledged.

courses.title: Private and Couples Constellation Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sessions by video call or in person in Manhattan, where Luisa sets up the family system inwardly through guided imagery, plus longer sessions for couples in a private workshop setting. First individual sessions have a fixed fee and later ones are on a sliding scale.
